in_marathi.name: Srinivasulu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Abode of Lakshmi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Srinivasulu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Srinivasulu is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Sri’ (meaning wealth, prosperity) and ‘Nivasa’ (meaning abode). This name is believed to denote the abode of the Goddess of Wealth, Lakshmi. In Hinduism, it is believed that invoking the blessings of Goddess Lakshmi brings prosperity, abundance, and good fortune.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Srinivasulu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Srinivasulu is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Sri’ (meaning wealth, prosperity) and ‘Nivasa’ (meaning abode). This name is believed to denote the abode of the Goddess of Wealth, Lakshmi. In Hinduism, it is believed that invoking the blessings of Goddess Lakshmi brings prosperity, abundance, and good fortune.
